jobs.title: Sustainability Data Specialist
jobs.description:
In Short:

On's mission is to become the leading premium sportswear brand rooted in design, performance and sustainability. To drive this commitment, we are looking for a dedicated Sustainability Data Specialist in Zurich who will support our data efforts for our sustainability ambitions and requirements. Contributing to our annual GHG accounting, you will be responsible for collecting, validating, and calculating Scope 1-3 data, and building end-to-end data flows to transform raw source data into actionable metrics. Leveraging your track record in carbon accounting and data engineering, you will execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with Tech and business stakeholders to streamline data workflows and systems, while supporting the Product Sustainability, Traceability, and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data needs. If you are data-savvy with a track record in GHG accounting and are looking to make an impact in a growing sportswear brand, this role is for you!

Your Mission:

• Collect, validate, and calculate Scope 1-3 data and manage relationships with data owners.

• Model and map end-to-end sustainability data flows from source systems to reporting tools, transforming raw data into actionable metrics.

• Identify opportunities to streamline data workflows and systems in collaboration with Tech teams.

• Execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements (e.g., CSRD).

• Support Product Sustainability, Traceability and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data collection, visualization, and engineering tasks.

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related field.

• Min. 1 year of experience in sustainability data with a track record in carbon accounting, expert in GHG Protocol.

• Ability to code in Python for data processing and automation of tasks.

• Experience with BigQuery or similar data warehouse architectures, including writing and optimizing queries.

• Proficiency in data management tools (Excel, Google Sheets).

• Strong understanding of sustainability metrics, reporting standards (such as SBTi), and global regulations.

• High attention to detail with the ability to structure and validate complex data.

• Ability to collaborate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

• Fluency in English.

• Passion for sustainability.

Meet The Team:

We are a small team with big responsibilities. We design and implement the sustainability strategy across On and help shape the future of the organization. We do research, create strategies and implement projects and innovate products and processes through the lens of sustainability. We are the strategic hub, setting the direction and pace for corporate impact by defining priorities, targets, and policies. We act as internal educators and enablers, providing tools and training, and then amplify our progress through clear communication internally and externally.

What We Offer:

A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint. A culture that fosters excellence and potential. This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth. The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

jobs.description:
Sr. Lead - Commercial Project & Strategic Initiatives (12-Months Maternity Cover)

At a Glance:
We are looking for a talented and strategic-minded individual to temporarily fill the Commercial Process & Project Lead role.
As Commercial Process & Project Lead, you will lead our process improvement initiatives and oversee the successful delivery of key projects within our organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive operational efficiency, enhance project management capabilities, and ensure the successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Your Team
You will be joining the Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion team - the command centre behind some of our most critical and high-impact strategic initiatives. This is where strategy turns into action and where we push ideas all the way to the finish line.

Operating at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, Tech, and regional markets, the team drives the programs that shape how we operate, scale our business, and unlock new growth opportunities. We take complex challenges, bring clarity and structure, and turn them into tangible results.

While anchored within the broader Commercial Operations setup, the team operates with a strong strategy and business development mindset, focusing on translating strategic priorities into execution that drives premium growth and commercial impact.

Think of us as the team that bridges strategy and execution, aligning the right people, making sharp decisions, and turning ambition into measurable business results.

If you’re energized by shaping direction, solving complex challenges, and driving real impact, you found your team!

Your Mission
- Team Leadership: Provide leadership and guidance to the process and project management team. Set clear goals, expectations, and priorities. Mentor and develop team members to enhance their skills and capabilities.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Foster positive relationships with internal stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and ensure stakeholder satisfaction. Manage expectations and resolve conflicts as needed.
- Pipeline Management: Coordinate and manage the commercial project pipeline and prepare projects for presentation during Quarterly Increment Planning.
- Capacity Management: Manage capacity within the Commercial Project Team to optimize efficiency and maximize productivity.
- Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of key organizational projects.
- Process Management: Oversee the development and implementation of process improvement initiatives across the organization.
- Communication: Maintain regular communication with stakeholders to provide project updates, address concerns, and manage expectations. Prepare and present project status reports, milestones, and deliverables for all commercial projects to the Cross-Functional Program Management Team.

Your Story
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
- At least 6 years of experience in project, process, or program management.
- Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices.
- Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, etc.) preferred.
- Strong understanding of process management and continuous improvement methodologies and tools.
- Proven leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams.
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
- Proficiency with project management tools and software such as Asana.
- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer
A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles, and challenges. On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Specialist - Apparel Developer
jobs.description:
In short

As a Junior Apparel Developer at On, you will play an active role in bringing high-performance apparel to life, contributing to innovative products that meet the demands of elite athletes and the next generation of performance consumers. You’ll support the end-to-end development process across seasonal collections and special projects, collaborating closely with Design, Materials, Innovation, and Sourcing teams.

You will join a small, agile development team focused on delivering world-class performance apparel. Working closely alongside a Senior Apparel Developer and Lead Developer, you will receive direct mentorship and hands-on guidance while taking responsibility for specific product areas. This provides a unique opportunity to accelerate your technical expertise, build your product knowledge, and contribute meaningfully to some of On's most innovative performance projects.

With a sharp eye for detail, a solid foundational knowledge of garment construction, and a solutions-driven mindset, you’ll help ensure every product meets On’s high standards for performance, quality, fit, durability, and innovation. This role requires an effective communicator who is eager to learn, capable of managing assigned projects efficiently, and deeply passionate about developing technically advanced performance apparel.

Your Mission:

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
This role will act as the leader and main point of contact when it comes to the bottom unit in the footwear development process. As a Footwear Tooling engineer, you will work in close collaboration with designers, developers and out sourcing hub in Asia to provide a smooth and effective transition from the concept creation, to prototyping and through to production. You will also be working closely with our Innovation and Sport engineering teams to help validate and bring high performance products and technologies to market.

• Provide Footwear technical designs constraints and solutions, material choices and product construction input by using your demonstrated knowledge of material, mold construction and manufacturing methods.

• Act as the bottom unit leader for product across multiples verticals and projects, not only Inline but Innovation as well.

• Analyse and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by offering solutions and still achieving quality and performance targets. Your skills in 2D-3D modelling will support these goals.

• Use your understanding of cost implementations of individual molding methods as well as actual tooling designs to give recommendations.

• Assist the development product management and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues, in addition of collaborating with our Asian counterparts and supporting moldshops teams.

• Hold a higher education degree in Engineering or Design fields.

• Have 5+ of experience within a engineering role working closely with development and production, preferably in FTW.

• Have experience working with 2D and 3D CAD FIles (Rhinoceros ideally). Experience in Simulation (FEA) as a bonus.

• Have excellent time management skills an the ability to work with multiples deadlines.

• Have technical knowledge in material, manufacturing, and plastic molding. Footwear is a world you know well.

• Have demonstrated expertise in project management, costing, quality, and abilities to provide solutions within complex constraints.

• Fluent in English

You'll be joining our growing team of five Tooling experts, a specialized group at the heart of our global Footwear Engineering team. Here, you will be fueled by a culture of relentless discovery, directly shaping the future of our products.

jobs.description:
At a Glance

We are looking for a Senior Specialist to join our Product Talent Acquisition team. You will be a hands-on contributor focused on delivering key Product Creation hires, collaborating closely with hiring managers and the broader TA team to build efficient, high-quality hiring processes. You bring strong sourcing and stakeholder management skills, and a deep commitment to candidate experience and excellent outcomes.

Your Mission

• Manage full-cycle recruitment processes for Apparel and Accessories Product Creation roles

• Partner with Apparel and Accessories Product Creation leaders to understand hiring needs, align on role profiles, and develop search strategies

• Drive sourcing, screening, stakeholder communication, and offer management with a focus on quality and clarity

• Collaborate with recruiting coordination and TA operations to ensure smooth and professional candidate experiences

• Use data and insights to support hiring decisions and improve search effectiveness

• Support broader TA initiatives such as tooling, processes, and employer branding as needed

Your Story

• You bring extensive experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on Product roles within fast-paced and international environments.

• Background in consumer goods companies or creative industries is highly preferred

• You have a proven track record of hiring across a range of disciplines within Product Creation

• A keen awareness of global and cultural trends that shape the world of brands

• You are confident partnering with hiring managers, providing market insights and clear recommendations

• You are proactive and hands-on with sourcing, skilled in tools like LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, etc.)

• You are passionate about delivering an excellent candidate experience and representing the brand professionally

• You thrive in collaborative, fast-moving environments and handle multiple priorities effectively

• Background in consumer goods companies, Luxury or creative industries is highly preferred

Your Team:

Being part of the talent team at On means consistently questioning the status quo. We don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable, and empower the team to drive the future of On. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Social Media - Running
jobs.description:
Social media is central to the On brand and key to connecting with our communities in a genuine way to communicate our brand mission ‘to ignite the human spirit through movement’.

Running is at our core and as we continue to grow we’re looking for an experienced social media creative to bring to life our Running campaigns and athletes stories across Instagram, TikTok, Strava and YouTube. You’ll collaborate with global marketing, strategy, creative, digital and art direction teams to land our key campaigns with our running communities. Reporting to the Lead - Global Social Media , you’ll be key to creating compelling stories for our social channels.

Your mission:

• Oversee all social media planning from conception to execution for our running campaigns, projects and events.

• Engage with our target communities through insight-led social content creation: with an ambition to disrupt run culture and deepen the connection to our athletes

• Develop and present brilliant ideas aimed at impacting running culture through social media to internal stakeholders

• Brief internal and external creative teams on socially-native content designed to entertain and be shared whilst maintaining a premium edge

• Comfortable capturing or directing content on campaign sets, as well as during live sporting eventsCollaborate closely with our internal athlete strategy team to concept and create insight-led stories with our world-class portfolio of athletes

• Demonstrate the ability to challenge conventions and the status quo, constantly seeking new ideas, methods, and technologies to improve social output

Your story:

• 5+ years’ working in a social media content creation role

• You may have experience working as a social media manager or social creative / social art director

• Passionate about running. You have a deep understanding of what running means to different people of varying abilities, from your everyday runners to elite runners, and everything in between

• Comfortable working autonomously with the ability to communicate efficiently with stakeholders of varying seniority

• Ability to implement and work towards self-imposed deadlines and timings that align with wider teams

• Live and breathe social media, staying on top of the latest content formats and trends is a must

• Proven track record of developing ideas and content strategies to deliver views and engagement across key channels like TikTok, Instagram, Strava and YouTube

• Be proactive and collaborative, with experience working in a high-performing team

• Brief and manage external creative partners (photographers, content creators, agencies)

• Strong communication and writing skills - presenting ideas and plans to marketing, strategy, communication, production and creative teams

• You have the desire to produce best-in-class content and experience in producing or commissioning content yourself

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Real Estate Analysis
jobs.description:
In Short:

Join our fast-growing global sports brand as a Senior Specialist - Real Estate Analysis for EMEA. We are accelerating our portfolio expansion of our own stores globally while also ensuring that the talented teams working in our offices have plenty of space to hire and grow together. In this role, you will ensure every decision is backed by rigorous data, every pro forma is accurate, and the transaction process moves with speed and precision. You will be instrumental in accelerating our portfolio expansion while optimizing our existing office and retail footprint.

Your Mission:

Market Research & Strategic Analysis

• Create comprehensive real estate analyses to advise the team on retail site selection. This includes generating reports on population growth, purchasing power, tourist traffic, footfall density, and competitor mapping.

• Go beyond the numbers by analyzing "soft metrics" such as the density of running/fitness communities, proximity to wholesale partners, and brand adjacencies to ensure locations match Ons values.

• Collect, synthesize, and analyze data from internal partners (E-commerce heatmaps, Sales performance, Marketing activations) and external broker partners to create benchmarks that ensure all real estate decisions are data-driven.

Financial Modeling & Deal Feasibility

• Build and maintain detailed real estate financial models in cooperation with Finance, Construction, and Operations.

• Run scenario planning to stress-test financial assumptions before management approval.

Transaction Management

• Draft Letters of Intent for new sites, ensuring all requests from Design and Construction are incorporated.

• Track the negotiation of terms across multiple concurrent sites. You will monitor milestones, flag delays, and make recommendations for counter-proposals.

• Support the legal process by acting as the project manager for lease negotiations—gathering inputs from internal stakeholders (Tax, Insurance, Construction, FM) and ensuring external counsel has the necessary commercial terms to proceed.

Portfolio Operations & Workplace

• Track office utilization in close collaboration with Finance, Talent, and Workplace teams. You will analyze attendance data to forecast future capacity requirements.

• Manage the critical path for the existing portfolio, tracking key milestone dates (break options, renewals, indexation).

• Support ad-hoc lease administration tasks, including onboarding suppliers to the internal payment system, processing invoices, and resolving rent payment issues to maintain positive landlord relationships.

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or Real Estate, preferably with international experience.

• Minimum 4+ years of professional experience in an real estate analytical role (e.g. finance, real estate, strategy), preferably across multiple countries within EMEA.

• Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in an real estate retail analytical role.

• Ability to analyze data efficiently, identify trends, and comfortably form insights.

• You are comfortable with P&L structures, cash flow modeling, and understanding the financial implications of lease terms.

• Organizational wizard skilled in staying ahead of deadlines, not missing key milestones, and tracking all upcoming deliverables.

• Highly motivated, responsible, capable of working in a self-driven, entrepreneurial environment both within a team and individually.

• Passionate problem solver who enjoys coming up with creative solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.

• Experience working within Google Workplace/Microsoft Office (other data analysis software, like Looker, a bonus).

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a plus.

Your Team:

Joining the Real Estate Development team at On means embracing a different approach. We do not simply adhere to traditional Real Estate practices; instead, we strive to build, grow, enable, and empower our teams to drive On's future. As part of Operations, Real Estate is regarded as a strategic navigator to all global spaces for On, helping to design, develop, build, and lead facilities for our retail spaces, retail partner spaces, office spaces, and beyond. Our team is growing. Come along for the journey.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
In Short:

Join our fast-growing global sports brand as a Senior Specialist - Real Estate Analysis for EMEA. We are accelerating our portfolio expansion of our own stores globally while also ensuring that the talented teams working in our offices have plenty of space to hire and grow together. In this role, you will ensure every decision is backed by rigorous data, every pro forma is accurate, and the transaction process moves with speed and precision. You will be instrumental in accelerating our portfolio expansion while optimizing our existing office and retail footprint.

Your Mission:

Market Research & Strategic Analysis

• Create comprehensive real estate analyses to advise the team on retail site selection. This includes generating reports on population growth, purchasing power, tourist traffic, footfall density, and competitor mapping.

• Go beyond the numbers by analyzing "soft metrics" such as the density of running/fitness communities, proximity to wholesale partners, and brand adjacencies to ensure locations match Ons values.

• Collect, synthesize, and analyze data from internal partners (E-commerce heatmaps, Sales performance, Marketing activations) and external broker partners to create benchmarks that ensure all real estate decisions are data-driven.

Financial Modeling & Deal Feasibility

• Build and maintain detailed real estate financial models in cooperation with Finance, Construction, and Operations.

• Run scenario planning to stress-test financial assumptions before management approval.

Transaction Management

• Draft Letters of Intent for new sites, ensuring all requests from Design and Construction are incorporated.

• Track the negotiation of terms across multiple concurrent sites. You will monitor milestones, flag delays, and make recommendations for counter-proposals.

• Support the legal process by acting as the project manager for lease negotiations—gathering inputs from internal stakeholders (Tax, Insurance, Construction, FM) and ensuring external counsel has the necessary commercial terms to proceed.

Portfolio Operations & Workplace

• Track office utilization in close collaboration with Finance, Talent, and Workplace teams. You will analyze attendance data to forecast future capacity requirements.

• Manage the critical path for the existing portfolio, tracking key milestone dates (break options, renewals, indexation).

• Support ad-hoc lease administration tasks, including onboarding suppliers to the internal payment system, processing invoices, and resolving rent payment issues to maintain positive landlord relationships.

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or Real Estate, preferably with international experience.

• Minimum 4+ years of professional experience in an real estate analytical role (e.g. finance, real estate, strategy), preferably across multiple countries within EMEA.

• Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in an real estate retail analytical role.

• Ability to analyze data efficiently, identify trends, and comfortably form insights.

• You are comfortable with P&L structures, cash flow modeling, and understanding the financial implications of lease terms.

• Organizational wizard skilled in staying ahead of deadlines, not missing key milestones, and tracking all upcoming deliverables.

• Highly motivated, responsible, capable of working in a self-driven, entrepreneurial environment both within a team and individually.

• Passionate problem solver who enjoys coming up with creative solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.

• Experience working within Google Workplace/Microsoft Office (other data analysis software, like Looker, a bonus).

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a plus.

jobs.description:
Senior Specialist - Procurement Category Manager Consumables

In short:

The Senior Specialist - Procurement Category Manager Consumables role will report to Senior Lead - Procurement Category Manager, Logistics on the Global Procurement team supporting the Global Supply Chain Transformation region/function/product. As our Sr. Specialist Procurement Category Consumables, you will be tasked with supporting the strategic sourcing and category management for high-impact consumables. Your primary focus will be managing categories such as corrugate, specialized packaging materials, and other warehouse consumables essential to our global distribution network across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas.

Your Mission:

• Category Strategy: Develop and execute flexible category management support for consumables, specifically focused on corrugate, tape, void fill, and other essential packing materials.

• Sourcing & RFP Management: Lead sourcing activities and business case creation for packaging initiatives, ensuring all decisions are supported by rigorous analysis and sustainability goals.

• Vendor Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with global packaging vendors to ensure operational visibility, quality control, and accountability.

• Value Engineering: Proactively identify and execute value engineering opportunities to optimize packaging design, reduce waste, and drive total cost of ownership (TCO) reduction.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular meetings with stakeholders from supply chain, operations, and finance to ensure alignment on consumables specs, lead times, and inventory levels.

• Operational Reporting: Create and standardize internal reports to drive continuous visibility into spend, multi-channel packaging usage, and supplier performance.

• Continuous Improvement: Troubleshoot issues within the consumables supply chain and develop action plans to drive business optimization and cost savings.

• Innovation Support: Work closely with product and sustainability teams to test and implement new, eco-friendly packaging materials that align with On's mission.

Your Story:

• Packaging Expertise: Ability to understand and articulate operational root cause analysis as it relates to packaging performance and distribution efficiency.

• Commercial Credibility: Skill to quickly build credibility and trust with external vendors and internal stakeholders during technical and commercial negotiations.

• Value Creation: A self-starter who proactively seeks business optimization and cost savings through data-driven business cases.

• Accountability: Ability to maintain and track critical action items and serves as a ‘single source of truth’ for consumables data.

• Resilience & Diplomacy: Capacity to be a change agent, demonstrating persistence and resiliencies when navigating market fluctuations in raw materials.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• Strong demonstrated ability to work independently, manage data-intensive projects, and engage remote teams.

• Excellent discretion, judgment, tact, and diplomacy when dealing with sensitive commercial information.

• Solid business judgment, including the ability to anticipate the impact of procurement decisions on the global supply chain.

• Must demonstrate an energetic, positive, helpful demeanor and a passion and interest in On Running.

• A Bachelor’s degree; however, a combination of college education and related work experience may be used as a substitute.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, category management, or a specialized packaging role in a fast-paced environment.

• Expert knowledge and proficiency with MS Office applications.

• Proficiency with modern sourcing and procurement tools (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, or similar platforms).

Your Team:

You are part of the Global Supply Chain team, reporting into the Sr. Lead Procurement Category Manager Outbound. In this role, you will work and collaborate with various functions, including Inbound/Outbound Logistics, Finance, IT, and Legal. You will be actively collaborating with team members across both regional and global teams, as well as our 3rd party logistic partners (3PLs) and packaging suppliers.

What We Offer:

We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Payroll, South Europe
jobs.description:
In short

Our Talent (HR) team is heavily expanding to support On’s explosive growth, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join us as Senior Payroll Specialist in the Talent Operations Team. This role is for someone who has experience in Payroll Operations, ideally in a fast-paced, scale-up and retail environment. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys researching new challenges, appreciates a streamlined and supportive process, and has a passion for innovative solutions. While France & Italy will be your main focus, you will also support other EMEA entities.

Your Team:

Being part of the Talent team at On means doing things differently, we don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable and empower the team to drive the future of On. The Talent Operations team strives to create and deliver a seamless and positive employee experience at all times. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

Mission:

• Process and manage the end-to-end payroll cycle in France, Italy, Spain and Portugal, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations:

• Preparation of payroll input for your external vendors, including regular pay, overtime, bonuses, benefit in kind and applicable deductions

• Reviewing the payroll drafts provided by the external vendors, ensuring payroll accuracy in alignment with local payroll regulations

• Managing different payroll schedules incl. Retail and ensuring timely salary payments and payslip distribution

• Delivering month-end payroll reports to the finance team, reconcile payroll accounts and resolve any discrepancies identified together with Finance

• Responsible for enrolling our team members into local benefits, such as health insurance and pension schemes.Address payroll-related inquiries and issues from employees and business leaders in a timely and professional manner

• Prepare by law mandatory payroll documents such as Attestation employeur, Certificat de travail and others depending on the country specifics

• Collaborate with Talent and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration between payroll, HR & Finance systems

• Own the country specific solution for data integration or data feed between On systems (Workday) and external payroll vendor

• Communication with authorities, insurances and other benefit providers in respective countries

• Collaboration with internal teams such as HR specialists, Business Partners and Total Rewards, to drive forward new initiatives.

• Design the payroll process in your respective countries in alignment with internal SOX controls, and contribute to the continuous optimization and automation of existing payroll process and systems

• Set up of payroll operations in new markets/entities, in collaboration with regional lead, local HR Specialist and other internal On teams

• Conduct regular audits of payroll records to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Responsible for our ESS (equity) and fringe benefits reporting through payroll

• Ensure compliance with more complex employment setups, such as cross-border employment or relocation cases

• Eagerness to take over more payroll countries, as we open new markets.

Your story:

• 4+ years work experience in payroll in France or Italy. Any other country is a plus

• Experience in payroll for Retail population for any of the countries of scope is a huge plus

• Excellent operational, legislative and best practice payroll knowledge in France or Italy

• Excellent stakeholder management, attention to detail, used to handling confidential data, and analytical approach

• Experience working with external payroll providers

• Excellent excel skills

• Fluency in English and at least one other local language. Any other language is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Payments & Risks
jobs.description:
In short:

In this role, you are ensuring the commercial heartbeat of our business never skips a beat. With a primary focus on our retail environment , you act as the vital link between our physical stores and our digital infrastructure. You understand that in high-stakes retail, payment availability is the foundation of the customer experience: no payments, no sales.

Your Mission:

• Payment Lifecycle & Settlement Oversight: Monitor the end-to-end flow of transactions from POS hardware through to the merchant bank account. You will ensure that processing cycles are completed accurately.

• Platform Administration & User Management: Serve as the lead administrator for our payment gateways and processing portals. This includes managing complex user hierarchies, assigning role-based permissions, and ensuring secure access for both retail staff and corporate finance users.

• Account & Merchant Maintenance: Own the operational setup and maintenance of Merchant IDs and Terminal. You will manage the lifecycle of these accounts, ensuring new retail locations are onboarded correctly and existing configurations are optimized for processing efficiency.

• Retail Tech & Finance Collaboration: Act as the operational bridge between Retail Tech (who manage hardware) and Finance (who manage reconciliation). You will ensure that the technical configuration of our payment stack provides the clean, granular data required for financial reporting.

• Data Analysis & Optimization: Utilize large datasets to monitor the "health" of our processing. You will investigate "leakage" (failed transactions), identify root causes for high latency at the point of sale, and monitor processing fees to ensure cost-efficiency.

Your Story:

• Operations & Administration Expertise: Proven experience managing payment platforms, gateway back-offices, or merchant acquiring portals. You are comfortable navigating complex administrative interfaces to manage users and system settings.

• Processing Knowledge: A deep understanding of the mechanics of payments, including the roles of acquirers, processors, and card schemes.

• Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to speak "tech" with hardware engineers and "finance" with accountants, ensuring that operational changes satisfy the requirements of both departments.

• Analytical Precision: Strong quantitative capabilities for data processing and numerical analysis. You can look at raw transaction logs or settlement reports and spot the correlations that indicate a systemic processing issue.

• Business Management Principles: A solid grasp of organizational workflows and business logic, specifically regarding how payment operations support the broader P&L.

Attributes of a succesful candidate

• Process Architect: You aren't satisfied with manual workarounds. You are constantly looking for ways to standardize and automate to make the "engine room" run more efficiently.

• Systems Thinker: You don't see a payment as an isolated event; you see it as a journey. You naturally map out how a change in the Retail Tech stack will affect the data flow into Finance and other subsystems.

• Operational Resilience: You remain calm and methodical when processing latencies occur. You prioritize stability and have a "bias for uptime", ensuring the retail floor never feels the friction of back-end maintenance.

• Collaborative Translator: You are a skilled communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.

• Data-Curious: You don't wait for a problem to arise; you proactively dive into processing logs and datasets to find "leakage" or inefficiencies that others might overlook.

Your Team:

We power Payment Excellence with seamless processing and smart fraud prevention across all sales channels - driving scalable infrastructure behind the world’s most premium global sportswear brand

As a Senior Specialist for Payment Processing & Operations , you will be the guardian of our payment flow. By mastering the administrative backend and maintaining the integrity of our merchant accounts, you provide the invisible infrastructure that allows our business to scale with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Group CAPEX
jobs.description:
In Short:

Are you the hands-on finance enthusiast we are seeking? We are looking for a process-oriented and numbers-driven team player to take ownership of our group-wide CAPEX. You will act as the financial architect of our global expansion, working at the intersection of Controlling, Retail, and Office Expansion teams. With your proven experience in accounting and a high affinity for modern cloud-based tools, you will take our CAPEX accounting to the next level.

Your Mission:

• Financial Integrity PPE: Act as the subject matter expert for the lifecycle of all fixed assets. This includes determining initial recognition, identifying subsequent expenditures that should be capitalized vs. expensed, and managing complex depreciation models and impairment testing.

• Financial Integrity IFRS 16: Lead the accounting for the global lease portfolio. This involves ensuring the accurate calculation of Right-of-Use assets and lease liabilities, managing lease modifications (extensions, terminations, or rent concessions), and ensuring all disclosures meet the latest IFRS standards.

• Operational Excellence: Oversee daily operations, including additions, disposals, depreciation, and re-measurements.

• Global Connectivity: Act as the primary contact for all CAPEX-related requests, bridging the gap between global standards and local needs.

• External Partner Management & Mentorship: Act as the primary point of oversight and quality control for our outsourced accounting provider. You will be responsible for reviewing their deliverables, and mentoring their team members to ensure alignment with our global standards and quality requirements.

• Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate disclosure in our consolidated IFRS Financial Statements and oversee internal SOX controls.

• Process Innovation: Actively challenge and automate global processes using our digital toolkit.

• Strategic Documentation: Create and maintain robust process documentation and user guidance to support a scaling organization.

Your Story:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance.

• Experience: 4+ years of practical experience within a large-scale or international corporate environment with a focus on IFRS and preferably CAPEX.

• Knowledge: Solid understanding of IFRS, with specific, hands-on experience in IAS 16 and IFRS 16. You should be comfortable navigating complex lease contracts and determining the correct accounting treatment for diverse global asset classes in autonomy.

• Effective Communication: Ability to navigate a matrix organization, effectively communicating complex financial concepts to stakeholders at all levels

• Tech Savvy: You are a power user of MS Excel and Google Workspace. Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus.

• Modern Toolkit: Familiarity with tools that drive automation and leverage AI to optimize financial workflows.

• Mindset: A hands-on mentality with the ability to adapt to a constantly changing environment.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical skills and business proficiency in English.

Meet The Team:

Join an international finance team that acts as both the backbone and the advanced navigator of our speedboat. We constantly challenge the status quo to handle rapid growth. We shape tomorrow’s best practices by thinking differently, acting cross-functionally, and leveraging a cutting-edge tech stack.

What We Offer:

A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint. A culture that fosters excellence and potential. This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth. The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Footwear Design
jobs.description:
In short

We are excited to offer the position of Senior Specialist – Footwear Design Performance (Team Sports) within our Design team. In this role, you will contribute to the creation of next-generation performance footwear for team sports, translating athlete insights, biomechanical data and advanced technologies into innovative design solutions.

You will operate in a fast-paced environment where the full design process — from concept exploration to production briefing — is driven by performance, precision and speed. Working at the intersection of sport science, computational design, AI-enabled workflows and advanced manufacturing, you will help shape the future of performance footwear within the Team Sports category

Your Mission:

• You will be an integral part of the Performance Footwear Team Sports vertical, contributing to the development of high-performance products built for elite athletes.

• You will own projects across the full design process — from initial research and concept creation through final commercialization.

• You will translate athlete insights, biomechanical analysis and sport-specific movement patterns into meaningful design solutions that elevate performance on the field.

• You will develop concepts, mockups, visuals, and high-quality 2D and 3D assets, supporting rapid iteration and clear communication across teams.

• You will leverage advanced digital workflows including 3D design, computational tools and AI-driven ideation to accelerate concept exploration and innovation.

• You will collaborate closely with sports engineering, biomechanics and testing teams to validate and refine performance hypotheses.

• You will work closely with our development partners in Vietnam, traveling two to four times per year to finalize prototypes and bring concepts to production.

• You will contribute to shaping On’s design vision and creative culture, pushing the boundaries of performance footwear within the Team Sports category.

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field.

• Proven experience in performance footwear design (5+ years), preferably within team sports or sport performance categories.

• Strong understanding of athlete needs, movement patterns and performance requirements within team sports.

• Expert skills in sketching and storytelling, combined with strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.

• Advanced knowledge of 3D design tools such as Maya, ZBrush, Blender, Rhino or similar platforms.

• Experience with AI-enabled creative tools, generative design workflows, and computational approaches to design exploration.

• Understanding of footwear construction, materials and industrial manufacturing processes.

• Hands-on mindset with the ability to build physical mockups and proof-of-concept prototypes.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate design ideas within cross-functional teams.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Your Team:

As part of the On Design team, our mission is to disrupt the performance footwear landscape through innovative, athlete-driven design. By combining design excellence, engineering precision and emerging digital tools, we translate athlete needs into high-performance products that push the boundaries of sport.

Working at the intersection of design, innovation, development, sport science and testing, we create footwear that delivers performance without compromise — merging functional excellence with progressive design.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Color Designer Performance Footwear

titleByLocale.en: Senior Specialist - Color Designer Performance Footwear
titleByLocale.it: Senior Specialista - Color Designer Performance Footwear
titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist - Color Designer Performance Footwear
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Spécialiste - Color Designer Performance Footwear

jobs.description:
In short:

Color has the power to shape our thoughts, moods, and emotions, influencing us both physiologically and psychologically. As a Senior Color Designer for Performance at On, you play a pivotal role in redefining the brand's identity through a disruptive, top-of-the-line color strategy. This is not a role for someone who just "colors within the lines"—we are looking for a visionary who creates the color blocking that completely changes product architecture and shifts how the brand reads on the track, road, and court. You will craft compelling, elite color stories that resonate with high-performance athletes, align with brand values, and drive the future of our fast-paced performance categories.

Your Mission:

• Disruptive Color Blocking & Creation: Lead the creation of innovative color blocking strategies that alter product perception, maximize visual impact, and redefine how performance products read on and off the road, track, and court.

• Elite Performance Contextualization: Strategize and execute consumer-focused color work specifically tailored to the elite performance world.

• Independent Project Management: Act as an autonomous force, efficiently managing workloads through a rapid, fast-paced environment.

• Out-of-the-Box Narrative Building: Develop highly creative narratives that push boundaries while maintaining a connection to the overarching CD color umbrella, utilizing advanced renders and dynamic visual communication to bring these concepts to life.

• Cross-Functional Synergy (Apparel HT2): Deeply collaborate with the Apparel Color Design team to constantly check, co-create, and lock in Head-to-Toe (HT2) integration for our elite performance gear, ensuring a unified brand statement.

• Cross-Functional Influence (Inline Footwear): Act as the "lightning strike" for the Inline Performance Footwear team; be highly proactive and vocal in sharing these collaborative insights and elite concepts, ensuring the energy successfully trickles down to influence and shape the commercial footwear area.

• Digital & Physical Execution: High-level execution of color CADs, PLM data management, and the continuous building of a cutting-edge digital and physical inspiration library rooted in contemporary art, culture, and sports fashion.

• Strategic Stakeholder Presentation: Present complex color proposals, concepts, and emotional narratives with high-fidelity renders and clear visual communication to gain immediate buy-in from internal leadership and external partners.

Your Story:

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, Color Sciences, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in the footwear industry, with a proven track record specifically within high-performance footwear.

• A portfolio that demonstrates "out-of-the-box" thinking, complex color-blocking expertise, and an innate understanding of how color interacts with movement.

• Demonstrated ability to work completely independently, self-manage stress, and make critical design decisions under tight deadlines.

• Deep technical knowledge of color processes across technical, performance-driven materials.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and 3D visualization programs.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); any additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

Our Color Team plays a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and aesthetic appeal of our products across all categories. Comprising talented professionals with diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates seamlessly to deliver innovative and trend-setting designs that resonate with our consumers and elevate our brand presence in the market. In essence, our Color Team serves as the creative powerhouse pulling together past, present, and future perspectives to drive the visual experience of our products. Through a collaborative and multidisciplinary approach, we craft compelling color design solutions that captivate consumers, differentiate our brand, and inspire lasting connections in the competitive marketplace.

As a Senior Color Designer for Performance at On, you play a pivotal role in redefining the brand's identity through a disruptive, top-of-the-line color strategy. This is not a role for someone who just "colors within the lines"—we are looking for a visionary who creates the color blocking that completely changes product architecture and shifts how the brand reads on the track, road, and court. You will craft compelling, elite color stories that resonate with high-performance athletes, align with brand values, and drive the future of our fast-paced performance categories.

Your Mission:

• Disruptive Color Blocking & Creation: Lead the creation of innovative color blocking strategies that alter product perception, maximize visual impact, and redefine how performance products read on and off the road, track, and court.

• Elite Performance Contextualization: Strategize and execute consumer-focused color work specifically tailored to the elite performance world.

• Independent Project Management: Act as an autonomous force, efficiently managing workloads through a rapid, fast-paced environment.

• Out-of-the-Box Narrative Building: Develop highly creative narratives that push boundaries while maintaining a connection to the overarching CD color umbrella, utilizing advanced renders and dynamic visual communication to bring these concepts to life.

• Cross-Functional Synergy (Apparel HT2): Deeply collaborate with the Apparel Color Design team to constantly check, co-create, and lock in Head-to-Toe (HT2) integration for our elite performance gear, ensuring a unified brand statement.

• Cross-Functional Influence (Inline Footwear): Act as the "lightning strike" for the Inline Performance Footwear team; be highly proactive and vocal in sharing these collaborative insights and elite concepts, ensuring the energy successfully trickles down to influence and shape the commercial footwear area.

• Digital & Physical Execution: High-level execution of color CADs, PLM data management, and the continuous building of a cutting-edge digital and physical inspiration library rooted in contemporary art, culture, and sports fashion.

• Strategic Stakeholder Presentation: Present complex color proposals, concepts, and emotional narratives with high-fidelity renders and clear visual communication to gain immediate buy-in from internal leadership and external partners.

Your Story:

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, Color Sciences, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in the footwear industry, with a proven track record specifically within high-performance footwear.

• A portfolio that demonstrates "out-of-the-box" thinking, complex color-blocking expertise, and an innate understanding of how color interacts with movement.

• Demonstrated ability to work completely independently, self-manage stress, and make critical design decisions under tight deadlines.

• Deep technical knowledge of color processes across technical, performance-driven materials.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and 3D visualization programs.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); any additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

Our Color Team plays a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and aesthetic appeal of our products across all categories. Comprising talented professionals with diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates seamlessly to deliver innovative and trend-setting designs that resonate with our consumers and elevate our brand presence in the market. In essence, our Color Team serves as the creative powerhouse pulling together past, present, and future perspectives to drive the visual experience of our products. Through a collaborative and multidisciplinary approach, we craft compelling color design solutions that captivate consumers, differentiate our brand, and inspire lasting connections in the competitive marketplace.

titleByLocale.en: Senior Specialist Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.it: Senior Specialista Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Spécialiste Accounting, EMEA (9 Months Contract)

jobs.description:
In short:

We are seeking a passionate Senior Specialist Accounting to join our EMEA Accounting team for an 9-month maternity leave coverage (ideally from September to the end of May). In this temporary role, your primary mission will be to maintain continuity and excellence in our core accounting operations across our EMEA entities. While your main focus will be on keeping the daily wheels turning in our fast-paced environment, your strong systems affinity will also help support our ongoing process improvements. Join our forward-thinking team and help us navigate this exciting phase of our growth journey!

Your Mission:

● Core Accounting Operations: Ensure proper financial accounting as well as the timely and compliant monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing & reporting processes for all EMEA entities, in accordance with Group accounting policies (IFRS) and local GAAP

● Statutory Compliance: Manage local statutory account filings across all entities in collaboration with external service providers

● Internal Controls: Conduct internal controls in accordance with Group requirements in a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls environment

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner internally with cross-functional teams to keep systems aligned and ensure day-to-day accounting and finance requirements are met

● Process & Business Continuity: Support the adaptation of accounting processes to align with business changes (such as new Marketplaces), and identify baseline opportunities for automation and operational streamlining where feasible

● Ad Hoc Support: Contribute to exciting ad hoc and project tasks in an emerging environment as needed

Your Story:

● Minimum 4 years of experience in accounting or broader Finance in an agile and fast-paced environment.

● Proven ability to step in quickly, take ownership of multiple financial matters simultaneously, and maintain operational stability in a dynamic setting.

● Experience and ability to identify operational improvement opportunities and provide solutions to streamline processes.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and keep core processes running smoothly.

● An outstanding communicator and collaborator with the ability to quickly build trust and influence a wide range of stakeholders.

● Highly tech-literate with strong general systems skills; proficient in navigating major ERP systems (ideally MS Dynamics 365 F&O) and comfortable leveraging tools that drive automation and leverage AI to optimize financial workflows

Your Team:

Join a finance team that acts as both the backbone and the advanced navigator of our speedboat. We constantly challenge the status quo to handle rapid growth. We shape tomorrow’s best practices by thinking differently, acting cross-functionally, and leveraging a cutting-edge tech stack.

jobs.description:
At a Glance:

One of the fastest-growing premium sportswear brands is seeking a Product Controller to join the fast-paced Product & Commercial Finance team. With your business partnering experience and your top-notch analytical skills, your mission is to be the financial navigator and partner to our industry-leading product and commercial teams, creating value by providing insights and supporting decision making. Critical to the success of this role is a collaborative and curious mindset, a desire to drive On’s growth journey and an ability to understand your audience and communicate your message clearly.
 Please note this is a temporary 9-month contract, with a target start date on August 1,2026.

Your Team:

We are the advanced navigators at On. We partner across functions to steer the business by analyzing the past and predicting the future. We specialize in accurate planning, relevant analysis and clear and simple reporting to drive impactful actions. We work across On, with every team, to gain insights into the business from different perspectives, and to ensure that all of our numbers are accurate and understood. If you are passionate about analytics, excited about understanding what makes On the fastest-growing running brand in the world, and are eager to work cross-functionally to deliver insights and analytics - come and join us!

Your Mission:

• Be the financial navigator to our Commercial & Product Strategy teams and product creation and vertical leads to drive On’s Apparel & Accessories portfolio strategy through the utilization of insights and trends to support the development of specific product strategies

• Be the financial business partner for Lifestyle - Product Strategy team by creating reports, optimizing dashboards, delivering insights, facilitating this way decision making and transparency with clear and action-oriented insights on product performance and KPI measurement to ensure accountability

• Proactively drive the Go To Market process through steering financial planning goals, aligned to On’s long-term financial ambition by partnering with global and regional merchandising and Integrated Business Planning teams

• Lead seasonal target setting with the Product Strategy team in line with global financial ambitions

• Deliver clear messaging regarding sales aspirations and margin targets to the Product and Costing Boards during Line Reviews

• Collaborate with Product Operations team to drive integration of information between product system, reporting and planning tools

• Collaborate with the Cost Analytics team to provide Product Managers and Vertical Leads with regular reporting including SKU efficiency reporting and margin/FOB support.

Your Story:

• 7-10 years experience in Controlling, FP&A or Business Partnering in an agile, high-growth environment

• Experience / Understanding of product lifecycle and product strategy highly preferred

• Education in the field of Business Administration or Finance

• Exceptional analytical skills, the ability to combine classical metrics with innovative storytelling, and a philosophy of letting data find a voice

• Cross-functional team-worker, able to demystify data and provide the support to the business to deliver the wow

• Excellent English skills, and possessing a work permit for Switzerland

• Experience with finance, analytics and data technologies such as Microsoft Dynamics, Looker and Anaplan

jobs.description:
In short:

On is looking for a pragmatic, business-minded lawyer to join our Intellectual Property Team as Senior Lead, Intellectual Property & Brand Protection Counsel. In this role, you will play a critical role in proactively protecting On’s trademarks, designs, and innovations. You will thrive here if you can independently manage complex matters, anticipate issues before they escalate, and provide clear, practical advice in a fast-moving global business.

Your Mission:

• Advise global and regional teams on a broad range of intellectual property matters, including brand protection, anticounterfeiting, and enforcement.

• Lead global brand protection and anti-counterfeiting investigations and actions efficiently and aligned with business objectives.

• Develop and implement enforcement strategies.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholder groups, conduct trainings and raise IP awareness.

• Build scalable processes, playbooks, and guidelines and drive practical solutions that reflect both global priorities and regional requirements.

• Support strategic IP projects as needed.

Your Story:

• Law degree and 7+ years of legal experience, including in-house experience.

• Experience at a global consumer-facing brand is preferred.

• Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance legal risk and business objectives.

• Excellent negotiation, communication (Fluent English) and analytical skills.

• Ability to provide clear, practical advice in high-pressure, fast-moving environments.

• Collaborative style and strong relationship-building skills across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Process-minded and curious, with a track record of improving how legal work gets done.

• Comfortable operating independently, prioritizing effectively and working across unfamiliar legal or business issues.

Your Team:

Being part of the On Legal Team means working as an entrepreneurial, solutions-oriented partner to the business. We move quickly, think commercially, and work closely across regions and functions to help On grow responsibly. You will have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to shape intellectual property at On.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Last Engineer
jobs.description:
In Short

At On, the secret to our signature cloud-like sensation starts from the inside out. The last is the very foundation of our footwear, dictating fit, performance, and aesthetic. We are seeking a visionary Senior Lead Last Engineer to pioneer the creation, optimization, and management of our footwear lasts across all product categories.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between biomechanics, design, and manufacturing. You will serve as the central authority on all last-related topics, ensuring our performance running, fashion, and lifestyle shoes deliver the ultimate fit and experience for our global community.

Key Responsibilities

• Standardization & Consolidation: Establish clear standards and best practices for all new last creations. Champion the implementation of these guidelines across internal teams and suppliers to strategically consolidate and optimize our existing last library.

• Last Creation & Internal Consulting: Lead the hands-on creation of new lasts while acting as the primary technical consultant for Design, Development, and Innovation teams regarding last grading, selection, and fit optimization for new and existing projects.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Build and manage strong, collaborative relationships with external last suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality, precision, and timely delivery.

• Library Management: Own and meticulously maintain our comprehensive digital and physical last libraries, ensuring all data is accurate, organized, and easily accessible to cross-functional teams.

• Sourcing & Production Support: Partner with the Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to resolve technical last challenges, streamline production processes, and provide expert guidance on last-related topics at the factory level.

• Process Innovation: Continuously evaluate and improve our last development workflows, integrating the latest 3D modeling technologies and fit-data insights.

Requirements

• Comprehensive Last Modeling Expertise: 8 years+ hands-on experience in last engineering across both high-performance running and fashion/lifestyle footwear. You must possess a deep understanding of dynamic fit, foot anatomy, and biomechanics, while also knowing how to balance complex aesthetic requirements with commercial fit standards.

• Program & Library Management: Proven experience managing comprehensive last development programs for a sports or performance footwear brand. Must possess exceptional organizational skills to build, consolidate, and seamlessly manage extensive digital and physical last libraries while juggling multiple development calendars from concept to mass production.

• Manufacturing Equipment Operation: Practical ability to utilize physical last manufacturing and digitizing equipment, specifically 3D scanners and milling machines, to create, reverse-engineer, and modify physical models.

• Technical & CAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in 3D CAD software relevant to last design and modification (e.g., Romans CAD, Rhino, or similar footwear-specific engineering tools).

• Industry Knowledge: Extensive understanding of footwear manufacturing processes, tooling, and grading principles.

• Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage extensive digital and physical libraries and juggle multiple development calendars simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and external suppliers.

About the Team

The Footwear Engineering team is a highly specialized collective of Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, and Last Engineers who hold the keys to the ultimate fit, feel, and ride of every On shoe. Rooted in our proud heritage of meticulous Swiss engineering, we obsess over every millimeter and material to craft the absolute best performance products for elite athletes and everyday consumers alike. We are the critical bridge between radical design and physical reality, working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where data-driven precision fuels our relentless dedication to human movement.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Footwear Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Lead Footwear Developer

In short:

As the Senior Lead Footwear Developer for Performance Running, you serve as the strategic technical consultant for our most critical product category. Based in our Zurich HQ, your role is to ensure high-level alignment between design intent and manufacturing feasibility. Rather than managing the granular execution of every product, you provide the technical governance and cross-functional support necessary to maintain performance integrity as the category scales.

The Senior Lead Development role will report to the Senior Lead Run Footwear Development on the Performance Run team supporting global footwear.

Your Mission:

• Technical Stewardship: Act as the primary technical advisor during the briefing and design phases to ensure performance running concepts are aligned with global manufacturing capabilities.

• Strategic Synchronization: Facilitate technical alignment between Zurich-based Design/Product Management and the Asia-based execution teams, ensuring that the "performance soul" of the category is preserved across all franchises.

• Process Enablement: Support the evolution of development standards by identifying technical bottlenecks and advising on best practices that improve category-wide efficiency.

• Advisory & Escalation Support: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for Asia-based development partners, providing guidance on complex technical hurdles and supporting the resolution of high-level production escalations.

• Performance Quality Assurance: Support the validation of fit, feel, and durability standards, ensuring that category-wide technical benchmarks are consistently met across different factory partners.

• Knowledge Facilitation: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring the broader development team and translating complex innovation breakthroughs into actionable development frameworks.

Your Story:

• Experience: 8–12 years in footwear development, with a background rooted in high-performance running and technical complexity.

• Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence product direction and technical outcomes through partnership and advisory, rather than direct line management or project ownership.

• Systemic Thinking: A deep understanding of how performance tooling, materials, and construction impact the global supply chain and product lifecycle.

• Collaborative Bridge: Exceptional at navigating HQ and regional dynamics, acting as a "technical translator" between creative vision and factory execution.

• Strategic Judgment: Highly skilled at evaluating technical trade-offs and providing recommendations that balance innovation with commercial scalability.

• Consultative Communication: A trusted voice capable of guiding stakeholders toward technically sound decisions while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• The Technical Advisor: You don't need to hold the pen on every tech pack, but you are the person everyone consults when a design pushes the boundaries of physics.

• The Strategic Partner: You focus on the "how" and "why," ensuring the category’s technical roadmap is robust and scalable.

• The Alignment Specialist: You thrive in the space between teams, ensuring that no technical detail is "lost in translation" between Zurich and our global manufacturing partners.

Your Team:

You will join the Zurich-based Footwear Development team, serving as a senior pillar of expertise for the Performance Running category. A high-performance collective of engineers, developers, and makers who serve as the technical heart of the brand. In Zurich, our team acts as the primary link between Biomechanical Research, Material Science, Design , and Sourcing, ensuring that every innovation is grounded in technical reality before it reaches the athlete.

Our mission is to relentlessly elevate the performance and technical attributes of our running footwear. We don't just facilitate product creation; we engineer the "ride." As part of the Performance Run vertical, you will be surrounded by specialists who are obsessed with creating the best fitting, performing and desirable running product in the market. We pride ourselves on a culture of technical rigor and "Swiss Engineering," where we challenge the status quo to solve the most complex biomechanical hurdles in the industry. Your role within this team is to ensure that as our category expands, our technical standards and the performance "soul" of our run footwear remain uncompromised.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Based at our Zurich HQ, you will be the driving force behind delivering the most premium sports products in the industry, championing groundbreaking creation and fearlessly challenging traditional processes to achieve it. By ensuring perfect alignment between design vision and manufacturing feasibility, you will set the standard for footwear creation. The Senior Lead Development role will report to the Head of Innovation Footwear, supporting the wider global footwear department.

Please Read Before Applying:
To ensure a smooth and efficient recruitment process, we kindly ask all applicants to submit their CV in English, as this is the working language of our company.

• Knowledge Facilitation: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring the broader development team and translating complex innovation breakthroughs into actionable development frameworks.

Your Story

• Experience: 8–12+ years in footwear development. A background rooted in high-performance footwear and technical complexity is preferred.

• Passionate product builder: You love to build product that makes athletes better, obsessing over the details and the athlete.

• Influential Leadership: Proven ability to influence product direction and technical outcomes through partnership and advisory, rather than direct line management or project ownership.

planning and competency build-up for effective market expansion across all channels. The role initially focuses on

Distributor Markets and Showroom roll-out, with a broader expansion view on commercial expansion readiness.

Your Team:

You will be joining the Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion team - the command centre behind some of our most critical and high-impact strategic initiatives. This is where strategy turns into action and where we push ideas all the way to the finish line.

Operating at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, Tech, and regional markets, the team drives the programs that shape how we operate, scale our business, and unlock new growth opportunities. We take complex challenges, bring clarity and structure, and turn them into tangible results.

While anchored within the broader Commercial Operations setup, the team operates with a strong strategy and business development mindset, focusing on translating strategic priorities into execution that drives premium growth and commercial impact.

Think of us as the team that bridges strategy and execution, aligning the right people, making sharp decisions, and turning ambition into measurable business results.

If you’re energized by shaping direction, solving complex challenges, and driving real impact, you found your team!

Your Mission:

• Develop and execute comprehensive commercial operational readiness plans for new market launches and expansion missions, defining ownership and timelines across key milestones and relevant workstreams

• Identify and mitigate potential commercial operational risks and challenges specific to channel and regional expansions, ensuring proactive problem-solving

• Lead the establishment of standard operating procedures, guidelines, and templates for commercial agreements and subsequent contract management in collaboration with regional stakeholders

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, product, etc.) to ensure alignment on commercial operational requirements and seamless GTM execution in line with regional expansion plans

• Serve as the central point of contact for all commercial operational readiness inquiries, facilitating effective communication and coordination across diverse teams

• Support regional Commercial teams in distribution partner onboarding and offboarding processes, adapting global tools and processes to local market realities

• Identify and map resource requirements (personnel, technology, budget) for commercial capability build-up in partnership with regional and global stakeholders to ensure clarity of roles and responsibilities

• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of commercial market expansion activities, monitor progress, and drive continuous improvement through regular reporting to stakeholders

Your Story:

• You have 8+ years of relevant project management experience, preferably in the Sports industry or global retail

• You are experienced in market-focused roles - experience outside Europe is a strong plus

• You have an ability to translate strategic goals into actionable commercial plans

• You have an understanding of global market dynamics and regional nuances

• You have a strong understanding of commercial operations processes and systems (GTM, CRM, ERP, etc.)

• You have an exceptional ability to build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships

• You have excellent communication and influencing skills

• You have experience working in global matrix organisations

What we offer:

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles and challenges.
