jobs.title: Senior Lead - Distributor Operations
jobs.description:
As the Senior Lead - Distributor Operations, EMEA, you will define and execute the operational strategy for premium footwear, apparel, and accessories across distribution networks in the Region. You will balance complex supply chain execution with deep collaborative partnership, bridging local regional logistics with global operational standards. Reporting to the Head of Regional Supply Chain on the EMEA team, you will guide a dedicated team to elevate orderbook management and drive process scalability that supports sustainable commercial growth across the region.

Your Mission

• Lead the end-to-end long-term strategy for omni-channel customer service and regional supply chain operations for distributor networks across EMEA

• Define and optimize distributor compliance initiatives, driving customer-centric value-added services, packaging standards, and localized labeling requirements

• Establish and document clear standard operating procedures across regional sales operations, compliance, and product supply to build a resilient operational foundation

• Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Logistics teams to streamline product flow, enhance supply visibility, and increase delivery efficiency

• Leverage business intelligence reporting tools to analyze shipment data, proactively escalating supply chain risks and implementing data-informed mitigation strategies

• Represent the EMEA region in global system testing, ERP enhancements, and organizational program initiatives to scale internal capabilities

• Build a collaborative and psychologically safe team culture focused on operational excellence, providing continuous mentorship and clear pathways for talent development

• Act as a change agent by leading and innovating the design and implementation of optimized ways of working to elevate distributor operations to a best-in-class standard

Your Story

• You bring 8+ years of functional experience in operations, logistics, or supply chain management within a premium omnichannel consumer goods brand

• You bring 2+ years of direct people leadership experience guiding operational teams and managing regional or distributor-focused service delivery

• Proven expertise operating within a high-growth environment, navigating complex distribution networks and regional compliance landscapes across EMEA

• Advanced systems capability including intermediate Excel modeling, automated reporting insights, and deep familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft D365

• Professional fluency in English with the ability to articulate complex operational problems concisely to both technical execution teams and senior leadership

• Exceptional problem-solving capability rooted in data analysis and root-cause mapping, with an approach that treats operational setbacks as learning opportunities

• Mobility and flexibility to align schedules and co-create workflows across international matrix environments, partnering with peers across Americas and APAC

Your Team

The EMEA Regional Supply Chain team is responsible for supporting, elevating, and improving the operational accountabilities for our distributor partners. We balance data-driven precision with commercial creativity, acting as the critical conduit between global strategy and regional execution. Moving at a dynamic pace, we work collaboratively to navigate supply chain complexities, establish scalable infrastructure, and ensure every touchpoint reflects our brand standard of excellence. We celebrate regional diversity, solve complex problems as a cohesive sports team, and are dedicated to delivering an exceptional experience to our fans and partners.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Distribution Procurement Category Manager

titleByLocale.en: Senior Lead - Distribution Procurement Category Manager
titleByLocale.it: Senior Lead - Responsabile di Categoria Distribuzione Procurement
titleByLocale.de: Senior Lead - Distribution Procurement Category Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Lead - Distribution Procurement Category Manager

jobs.description:
In Short:

On's success comes down to two reasons: incredible products - and incredible people. It has one simple mission: Ignite the Human Spirit Through Movement. Available today in over 50 countries and cited as “the fastest growing sports company in the world,” On shoes and Performance Running Gear have won design and technology distinctions the world over.

As our Sr. Lead Distribution Procurement Category Manager , you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategic sourcing and category management of our global warehousing and distribution network. You will be tasked with developing long-term category strategies that support On’s rapid growth while ensuring operational excellence and cost efficiency across our Distribution & Logistics portfolio.

Your Mission:

• Category Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies specifically for warehousing and distribution services globally.

• Sourcing & RFP Management: Lead complex RFPs and sourcing events for 3PL providers, ensuring all decisions are supported by rigorous financial and operational analysis.

• Commercial Negotiation: Drive end-to-end contract negotiations, focusing on total cost of ownership (TCO), service levels (SLAs), and long-term scalability.

• Warehouse Operational Design: Support the procurement of automation and technology solutions (e.g., MHE, robotics) to drive distribution center efficiency.

• Network Optimization: Collaborate on business case creation for new node entries, facility expansions, or site relocations within the EMEA and global network.

• Vendor Excellence: Establish robust SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) frameworks to drive accountability and continuous improvement with our logistics partners.

• Labor & Consumables Strategy: Manage the procurement of indirect warehouse needs, including temporary labor contracts and packaging/consumables strategy.

• Operational Visibility: Create and maintain standardized reporting tools to track category spend, vendor performance, and contract compliance.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular strategic alignment meetings with Supply Chain, Finance, and IT leadership to ensure procurement goals support the broader business roadmap.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify value-engineering opportunities to optimize our distribution footprint and drive sustainable cost savings.

Your Story:

• Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding of the warehousing and 3PL landscape, including cost models, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.

• Strategic Influence: Skill to quickly build credibility and trust with executive-level stakeholders and external partners.

• Analytical Precision: Ability to build data-driven business cases and perform complex root cause analysis to support sourcing recommendations.

• Process Discipline: Strong knowledge of procurement best practices, contract law, and project management methodologies.

• Accountability: Ability to serve as the ‘single source of truth’ for the distribution category, managing complex dependencies across the global network.

• Resilience: Capacity to act as a change agent, navigating market volatility and high-pressure negotiations with tact and diplomacy.

Basic Qualifications:

• A Bachelor’s degree (a combination of college education and related work experience may be used as a substitute).

• Minimum 5 years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, or a specialized logistics role in a fast-paced environment.

• Expert knowledge and proficiency with MS Office applications and experience with sourcing tools (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, etc).

Additional Skills:

• Strong demonstrated ability to work independently, manage data-intensive projects, and engage remote teams.

• Excellent discretion, judgment, and the capacity to handle sensitive commercial data.

• Solid business judgment, including the ability to anticipate the impact of procurement decisions on the end-to-end supply chain.

• Must demonstrate an energetic, positive, helpful demeanor and a passion for On Running.

What We Offer:

We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields. If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination. We are requesting that you provide sensitive demographic information such as gender identity and race/ethnicity to help us ensure that we are creating equitable and fair experiences for all potential future team members. You are not required to provide this demographic information and this information will in no way impact your eligibility for hire.

Available today in over 50 countries and cited as “the fastest growing sports company in the world,” On shoes and Performance Running Gear have won design and technology distinctions the world over.

As our Sr. Lead Distribution Procurement Category Manager , you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategic sourcing and category management of our global warehousing and distribution network. You will be tasked with developing long-term category strategies that support On’s rapid growth while ensuring operational excellence and cost efficiency across our Distribution & Logistics portfolio.

Your Mission:

• Category Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies specifically for warehousing and distribution services globally.

• Sourcing & RFP Management: Lead complex RFPs and sourcing events for 3PL providers, ensuring all decisions are supported by rigorous financial and operational analysis.

• Commercial Negotiation: Drive end-to-end contract negotiations, focusing on total cost of ownership (TCO), service levels (SLAs), and long-term scalability.

• Warehouse Operational Design: Support the procurement of automation and technology solutions (e.g., MHE, robotics) to drive distribution center efficiency.

• Network Optimization: Collaborate on business case creation for new node entries, facility expansions, or site relocations within the EMEA and global network.

• Vendor Excellence: Establish robust SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) frameworks to drive accountability and continuous improvement with our logistics partners.

• Labor & Consumables Strategy: Manage the procurement of indirect warehouse needs, including temporary labor contracts and packaging/consumables strategy.

• Operational Visibility: Create and maintain standardized reporting tools to track category spend, vendor performance, and contract compliance.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular strategic alignment meetings with Supply Chain, Finance, and IT leadership to ensure procurement goals support the broader business roadmap.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify value-engineering opportunities to optimize our distribution footprint and drive sustainable cost savings.

Your Story:

• Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding of the warehousing and 3PL landscape, including cost models, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.

• Strategic Influence: Skill to quickly build credibility and trust with executive-level stakeholders and external partners.

• Analytical Precision: Ability to build data-driven business cases and perform complex root cause analysis to support sourcing recommendations.

• Process Discipline: Strong knowledge of procurement best practices, contract law, and project management methodologies.

• Accountability: Ability to serve as the ‘single source of truth’ for the distribution category, managing complex dependencies across the global network.

• Resilience: Capacity to act as a change agent, navigating market volatility and high-pressure negotiations with tact and diplomacy.

Basic Qualifications:

• A Bachelor’s degree (a combination of college education and related work experience may be used as a substitute).

• Minimum 5 years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, or a specialized logistics role in a fast-paced environment.

• Expert knowledge and proficiency with MS Office applications and experience with sourcing tools (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, etc).

Additional Skills:

• Strong demonstrated ability to work independently, manage data-intensive projects, and engage remote teams.

• Excellent discretion, judgment, and the capacity to handle sensitive commercial data.

• Solid business judgment, including the ability to anticipate the impact of procurement decisions on the end-to-end supply chain.

• Must demonstrate an energetic, positive, helpful demeanor and a passion for On Running.

What We Offer:

We offer a dynamic, challenging and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team who is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields. If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination. We are requesting that you provide sensitive demographic information such as gender identity and race/ethnicity to help us ensure that we are creating equitable and fair experiences for all potential future team members. You are not required to provide this demographic information and this information will in no way impact your eligibility for hire.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Copy
jobs.description:
In short:

At On, we believe in the power of storytelling. Whether it's celebrating the achievements of our athletes, the passions of our communities, or the innovation behind our products – our stories captivate and inspire. Our Creative Studio is at the heart of it all, shaping campaigns that leave a lasting impact.

We’re looking for a highly experienced storyteller to craft copy and to concept industry-leading creative across our global campaigns. As Senior Copy Lead, you’ll work closely with Creative Directors and Art Directors to deliver impactful concepts and stories across channels. The ideal candidate is an expert conceptual storyteller with a deep understanding of channel best practices and leadership experience.

You strive for creative excellence in every brief, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You enter the creative process with foresight, identifying potential issues before they arise. You have a love of craft, and immerse yourself in global subcultures. You confidently navigate the creative journey from beginning to end: from strategic foundations, moving through significant conceptual development and production, and culminating in the final rollout.

The Senior Copy Lead - Running will report to the Head of Creative - Running in the Creative Studio.

Your Mission:

• Partner with Art Director to concept and execute innovative campaigns across all channels, bringing big ideas to life from briefs big and small.

• Confidently and articulately present creative ideas based on strategy and insights.

• Deliver concepts, films, OOH, and 360 campaigns with obsessive craft on ambitious timelines.

• Uphold and evolve On's distinctive voice, ensuring it remains fearless and unconventional.

• Lead creative in the Run category to success, fostering a sense of bravery and dedication within your team, ensuring they are motivated, inspired, and consistently delivering bold, original and inventive concepts and distinctive tones of voice for campaigns and projects.

• Manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously, making sound creative decisions independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events.

Your Story:

• A dynamic, experienced copywriter with 6+ years of experience as a creative championing big ideas on global advertising and/or marketing campaigns, brand side or at an agency.

• A passionate storyteller with a portfolio spanning film scripts, manifestos, OOH, and disruptive activations.

• Deep understanding of global digital user journeys and how to leverage touchpoints to drive meaningful action.

• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver commercial results.

• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.

• You know how to lead and inspire within your team, identify underlying issues and root causes, and seek solutions to problems.

• You have a deep love for, and experience in, culture, fashion, and performance sports.

Your Team:

On’s Brand Studio is an award-winning internal studio aiming to challenge world-leading creative agencies. At our core, we tell compelling stories and bring experiences to life. We channel the energy and global nature of the brand into our daily work and you can help us continue our fantastic run of successes. If you’re bursting with original ideas and have the drive and experience to see them realized, this is the team for you.

What We Offer:

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events.

• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver commercial results.

• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing

titleByLocale.en: Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.it: Senior Direttore of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.de: Senior Direktor of Creative Apparel Marketing
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Directeur of Creative Apparel Marketing

jobs.description:
At a Glance

As the Senior Director of Creative Apparel Marketing , you will serve as the primary brand partner to the creative and product leadership team Your mission is to translate product design vision into a cohesive brand creative language, acting as a guardian of the apparel portfolio while ensuring all marketing efforts align with global priorities. This is an enterprise-level leadership role that demands a blend of strategic marketing expertise and visionary creative direction to deliver high-impact campaigns at the intersection of fashion, performance, and contemporary culture.

Your Mission

Architect Creative Strategy & Vision

• Define the long-term, multi-year architecture for the apparel creative function, ensuring a unified global identity across all brand platforms.

• Translate product creative direction into compelling brand platforms that resonate across diverse global communities.

• Direct high-impact campaigns and collaborations , partnering with globally relevant talent, designers, and cultural voices.

• Establish and mandate KPIs and metrics (e.g., brand health, cultural relevance, portfolio value) to measure the systemic success of creative initiatives.

Lead Organizational & Creative Excellence

• Lead and inspire multidisciplinary creative teams , including art directors, copywriters, and spatial designers, nurturing ambition and clarity across the studio.

• Architect the global operating model for apparel brand creative, defining clear roles and decision-making rights between product, marketing, and commercial teams.

• Act as the primary interface between the creative function and Executive Leadership , communicating strategy, performance, and talent needs.

• Coach and mentor the team to raise the bar on both strategic thinking and execution quality .

Drive Enterprise Impact

• Simplify and prioritize a complex portfolio of brand initiatives to focus resources on the highest-value growth opportunities.

• Ensure creative synergies across all product categories, marketing channels, and regions.

• Champion creative excellence across every consumer touchpoint, from film and imagery to retail and digital experiences.

Your Story

• Executive Leadership: You are a recognized leader with 15+ years of progressive experience in brand management and creative direction within premium sportswear, fashion, or luxury industries.

• Managerial Depth: You have at least 8+ years of experience managing Director-level leaders and overseeing complex, multi-category portfolios.

• Strategic Architect: You possess the ability to build 5-year strategic plans and align the C-suite, regional presidents, and cross-functional EVP leadership.

• Creative Intuition: You are a creative mind rooted in design and culture, fluent in how aesthetics and meaning drive brand desire beyond standard categories—exploring art, architecture, and sound.

• Operational Gravitas: You navigate ambiguity with ease, balancing creative vision with the "system builder" mindset required to deliver executable frameworks for global teams.

• Communication Mastery: You have an exceptional executive presence and are comfortable presenting vision and performance to large internal and external audiences.

What We Offer

• A challenging role at the forefront of global expansion with unparalleled influence on long-term brand architecture.

• A culture that values experimentation, well-being, and individuality , providing the freedom to create and design for the long run.

• A commitment to an inclusive work environment as an Equal Opportunity Employer .

jobs.title: Sample Maker
jobs.description:
Sample Maker Job Summary:
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Sample Maker with a passion for athletic and ready to wear apparel. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality prototypes, muslins and mockups in partnership with pattern engineers, product development and designers to bring product concepts to life. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in fabric handling (both cutting and sewing), garment construction and sewing techniques. This person should be self driven and eager to continuously grow their skills in apparel development. This is a 6 month contract with potential for permanent.

Key Responsibilities:

• Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.

• Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.

• Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.

• Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.

• Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.

• Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.

• Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills:

Experience:

• 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.

• Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.

• Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).

• Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.

• Experience working with all fabrications

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team:

We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.

• Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.

• Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.

• Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.

• Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.

• Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.

• Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.

• Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills:

Experience:

• 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.

• Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.

• Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).

• Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.

• Experience working with all fabrications

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team:

We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.

jobs.description:
In Short

The world’s fastest-growing sports brand is seeking a passionate, hands-on Treasury expert to drive our global finance team forward. Working closely with colleagues across the globe, you will be a core part of On's Treasury function, helping to lead strategic projects and implementing new processes to support our global expansion.

Reporting to the Head of Group Treasury, this is a pivotal role where you will own and drive innovation across our Treasury function. You are the go-to data expert, leveraging exceptional analytical and corporate finance modeling skills to go beyond the numbers, uncover the 'why', and transform complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will be the true product owner of our entire treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query), championing innovation by embedding AI and automation into our daily operations. You will proactively challenge the wider team to redefine what is possible in the future of treasury, and play a crucial role in our journey to build a low-maintenance, high-value Treasury team.

Your Mission

• You go beyond the numbers to uncover the 'why,' challenging assumptions and building strong relationships across the business to masterfully craft and communicate the compelling financial stories that guide our path.

• You architect and build our treasury-focused data lake, creating a single source of truth. You use this platform to design and maintain live, interactive dashboards that deliver real-time, actionable insights to Treasury and management.

• You act as the ultimate sparring partner for the Treasury Core function, challenging their models and assumptions, providing data-driven action plans to drastically improve forecasting accuracy, and actively helping define key KPIs for strategic cash, FX, and financing steering.

• You use your strong financial acumen to support high-impact corporate financial modeling requests, analyzing statements and creating sophisticated models that propel strategic decisions across the company.

• You champion innovation by relentlessly embedding AI and automation into our treasury operations, using data-driven insights to inspire and challenge the wider team to embrace new, low-maintenance, high-value technologies.

• You own and continuously enhance our core treasury technology stack (including Kyriba, Palm, Looker and Looker Studio, Big Query, and FXall), proactively identifying, driving, and implementing improvements necessary to accelerate our global growth.

Your Story

• You are driven by a deep passion for data analytics and possess a natural talent for turning complex information into clear, actionable insights.

• We value your potential, analytical drive, and strong financial acumen most. While relevant professional experience from a role in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or a general Finance function is a bonus, your ability to perform ad hoc financial modeling, read and analyze financial statements, and assist with corporate finance models is key.

• You possess a solid knowledge of AI with a clear understanding of how to apply it to drive business value. You are an automation enthusiast who proactively builds workflows to eliminate manual tasks and streamline operations.

• You have a bias toward action and the attitude to try things out, iterate quickly, and find the best path forward.

• You bring an insatiable curiosity and a "tinker" mindset, with the initiative to experiment with new tools and learn through doing.

• You act as a true business partner, collaborating effectively across the organization—from IT and data specialists to accounting, controlling, and management.

• You’re fluent in English and can adapt your communication style to different audiences, both in terms of seniority and affinity to numbers.

Your Team

Join the forward-thinking, action-oriented Finance team—the speedboat's backbone and advanced navigator. We are committed to challenging the status quo, driving growth, and shaping tomorrow’s best practices through cross-functional action and leveraging the latest technology. To deliver controlled and sustainable growth, we require an entrepreneurial, results-driven mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and hands-on execution skills.

​​What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

jobs.title: Lead - Technology Product Manager
jobs.description:
Lead Technical Product Manager, Operations AI & Data

The Team

The Product Management Technology team is the digital backbone of On's product creation engine. We are a team of strategic product leaders who partner with core business functions—from R&D and Design to Sourcing and Supply Chain—to build the platforms and systems that power On's growth.

Our mission is to create a seamless, intelligent, and efficient digital ecosystem that enables our teams to design and deliver the next generation of revolutionary products. We are internal entrepreneurs, deeply embedded in the business, who identify complex challenges and build elegant, scalable solutions.

As a member of our team, you will have a unique opportunity to drive significant transformation and make a tangible impact on the future of one of the world's most exciting brands.

The Role

At On, our supply chain is the backbone of our global operation. We are looking for a visionary Lead Technical Product Manager to spearhead the next evolution of our supply chain by harnessing the power of Artificial Intelligence and data.

In this leadership role, you will be the bridge between our complex operational challenges and cutting-edge data solutions. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities where data, AI and automation can revolutionize our planning, logistics, and decision-making processes. Your expertise will be in understanding the business, the data, and the possibilities of AI to define a compelling product vision and guide our AI, data and engineering teams to build solutions that deliver immense value.

As a Lead, you will also play a key role in mentoring other product managers and shaping the product culture within the team.

What You'll Do

• Own the Data & AI Product Vision: Develop and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap for Data & AI-driven initiatives within the supply chain domain.

• Identify Opportunities: Collaborate closely and build relationships with supply chain stakeholders to deeply understand their processes, data challenges, and automation pain points.

• Translate Problems into Solutions: Convert ambiguous business problems into well-defined product requirements, user stories, and specifications for our data science and engineering teams to drive measurable value.

• Prioritize for Impact: Create and manage a data-driven product backlog, prioritizing features and initiatives that deliver the highest value to the business.

• Define Success: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness and impact of your AI/data products, in partnership with analytics.

• Bridge the Gap: Serve as the primary liaison between business leaders, supply chain operators, data scientists, and engineers, ensuring alignment and clear communication across all teams.

What You'll Bring

• Leadership Experience: Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager, with a demonstrated history of leading significant products or initiatives from concept to launch.

• Supply Chain Acumen: Strong experience with supply chain data and a solid understanding of core supply chain principles (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, logistics).

• AI/Data Fluency: You have a basic familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and, most importantly, a gift for translating business needs into data-driven solutions. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you must be adept at partnering with engineers and data scientists who are.

• Analytical mindset: You are able to creatively identify the right success metrics and analyses that will provide key insight into product functionality.

• Technical Aptitude: You are comfortable in a technical environment and capable of holding your own in discussions about data models, APIs, and system architecture.

• Strategic Problem-Solver: You excel at breaking down large, complex problems into actionable steps and have a strategic mindset to see the bigger picture.

• Exceptional Communication: You have an outstanding ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Lead - Commercialization Engineer
jobs.description:
In short:

As a Lead, Innovation commercialization engineer, you will be a driving force at the forefront of On's scale of product evolution. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy to lead complex projects, challenge conventions, and champion innovative approaches that define the future of footwear. This role requires you to master technical complexity, manage key stakeholder relationships, and translate visionary concepts into scalable, performance-driven products.

Your Mission:

• As a leader within the team, you will independently manage multiple high-impact footwear development projects from confirmation to production, defining methods and procedures for new assignments and potentially supervising other team members. As a senior contributor, you will leverage your expertise to guide and influence both management and your team.

• You will spearhead the end-to-end commercialization process, leveraging your expert knowledge of manufacturing processes, fit, material properties, mold and process manufacturing. Your strong root-cause analysis mindset will be crucial in troubleshooting significant and unique issues related to tooling, molding, assembly, fit, and wear.

• As the central hub for On’s key manufacturing regions, you will act as a critical liaison between On inline development and production teams, working closely with strategic vendors to ensure product intent is maintained while meeting commercial and operational requirements. You will engineer products for efficient manufacturability, lowest cost, and highest quality and performance.

• You will serve as a key influencer and central communication hub, managing expectations and negotiating effectively with diverse internal teams and major external T1/T2 partners and sourcing teams across regions.

• Collaborating with computational designers, you will work with upper patterns and tooling construction adjustments to enhance fit, durability, and ensure scalable manufacturing. You will be responsible for full size run grading, technical manufacturing operation manuals, initial production trial, ERP system update, scalability sign off, among others.

• You will own the documentation of complex tooling and upper-related issues, defining and communicating clear correction actions to all stakeholders for manufacturing guidelines.

Your Story:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in the footwear industry, with a significant focus on innovation and bringing new technologies to market.

• Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Engineering, Material Science, or another relevant technical field.

• 2D and 3D, computational design and algorithmic capabilities are a plus.

• Proven ability to not only lead the scaling of new technologies but also to assess their commercial viability and factory readiness.

• Expert-level knowledge of advanced footwear manufacturing processes, including robotics, automation, tooling, molding, injecting, welding, lasting, and assembly. You understand factory capabilities, tolerances, and limitations and know how to engineer for scalable replication.

• A natural technical curiosity and a robust, root-cause analysis approach to problem-solving.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to confidently present to senior management and external partners.

• A demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, navigating ambiguity and making independent judgments on complex and significant issues.

• Experience in mentoring junior team members or supervising project activities is a strong plus.

• Ability to travel up to 15-20% of the time.

Your Team:

On's Innovation team is an agile, interdisciplinary group of footwear creation, advanced manufacturing, and future of sport experts, driving On's future innovations and athlete-informed technologies that set On footwear apart.

We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to pioneer footwear innovation. As a member of the On Innovation Team, you will think outside the box and bring new, innovative ideas to life.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Testing
jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

jobs.title: Intern - Group Reporting
jobs.description:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Your team

We are a small, action-oriented Finance team with big responsibilities and impact across the organization. We evolve best practices by being forward-thinking, working cross-functionally, and leveraging the latest technology to uphold the integrity, accuracy, and transparency of On’s externally published financial reports. The Group Reporting team is responsible for On’s external financial reporting, consolidated financial statements, accounting policies, and technical accounting matters, in compliance with regulations.

Your mission

• Support with the preparation of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial reports filed with the SEC (U.S Securities and Exchange Commission) and published externally, in accordance with IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and SEC regulations. You will help ensure our externally published financial information is accurate and in compliance.

• Partner and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations and other teams to gather critical data and qualitative insights for our reporting.

• Assist in developing and implementing process improvements by leveraging AI and technology to streamline and automate group reporting processes.

• Assist with ad-hoc analysis, cross-functional projects, monthly consolidation tasks, accounting policies, and technical accounting memos.

Your story

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of accounting (IFRS considered a plus)

• Curious to learn more about the role of AI and automation in a Finance department

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Highly self-motivated individual with a positive and “can-do” mindset.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Your team

We are a small, action-oriented Finance team with big responsibilities and impact across the organization. We evolve best practices by being forward-thinking, working cross-functionally, and leveraging the latest technology to uphold the integrity, accuracy, and transparency of On’s externally published financial reports. The Group Reporting team is responsible for On’s external financial reporting, consolidated financial statements, accounting policies, and technical accounting matters, in compliance with regulations.

Your mission

• Support with the preparation of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial reports filed with the SEC (U.S Securities and Exchange Commission) and published externally, in accordance with IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and SEC regulations. You will help ensure our externally published financial information is accurate and in compliance.

• Partner and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations and other teams to gather critical data and qualitative insights for our reporting.

• Assist in developing and implementing process improvements by leveraging AI and technology to streamline and automate group reporting processes.

• Assist with ad-hoc analysis, cross-functional projects, monthly consolidation tasks, accounting policies, and technical accounting memos.

Your story

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of accounting (IFRS considered a plus)

• Curious to learn more about the role of AI and automation in a Finance department

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Highly self-motivated individual with a positive and “can-do” mindset.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.title: Intern - EMEA Sales Planning
jobs.description:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Meet the team

The Sales Planning team within the EMEA Wholesale department plays a key role in driving the business from long-range financial forecasting to monthly sales planning. The team manages in-season performance to ensure targets are met and supports pre-season assortment planning to optimize product and Accounts strategies. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Controlling, Demand Planning, and Operations, the team ensures alignment between commercial goals and operational execution. It is an innovative and constantly evolving function, continuously improving processes and tools to enhance business performance and agility.

Your mission

• Perform weekly business analyses and generate actionable insights to support the Sales and Management teams in decision-making.

• Contribute to sales planning activities, including financial forecasting, in-season tracking, and pre-season assortment planning.

• Enhance and develop analytical tools and files (e.g., sell-out dashboards, forecast roll-ups, invoice trackers, G2N by region/sub-region) to enable more data-driven sales decisions.

• Support and drive sales-related projects aimed at improving processes, tools, and overall department efficiency.

• Support on developing AI capabilities within the commercial function.

Your story

• Demonstrate a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and ownership of tasks with a “can-do” attitude.

• You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to support decision-making and identify business opportunities.

• A natural problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and find creative, practical solutions.

• Curious and eager to learn, showing genuine interest in understanding sales processes and business dynamics.

• You think outside the box and embrace challenges beyond your comfort zone to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

titleByLocale.en: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Strategy & Operations, you are the architect of Footwear Creation's operating model. You will translate On's 2030 Long Range Plan into executable transformation- driving the strategic initiatives, processes, and systems that enable our team to deliver breakthrough footwear with Swiss-engineered precision. Sitting at the intersection of Development, Engineering, Materials, and Sustainability, you will influence leaders across functions, build organizational excitement for new ways of working, and make decisive calls on initiative prioritization and execution. Your mission: own the LRP initiative portfolio, orchestrate the leadership operating rhythm, and deliver measurable transformation that elevates how we create.

Your mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action)

• Architect the Roadmap: Translate On’s 2030 LRP and annual goals into a multi-year strategic roadmap for Footwear Product Creation

• Strategic Prioritization: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the footwear portfolio, ensuring technical breakthroughs are sequenced and resourced for maximum commercial impact.

Portfolio Strategy & Operating Rhythm

• Own seasonal range portfolio planning: capacity modeling, resource allocation, project prioritization

• Design and manage the Footwear Creation operating rhythm: weekly leadership standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic planning

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Sitting at the intersection of Development, Engineering, Materials, and Sustainability, you will influence leaders across functions, build organizational excitement for new ways of working, and make decisive calls on initiative prioritization and execution. Your mission: own the LRP initiative portfolio, orchestrate the leadership operating rhythm, and deliver measurable transformation that elevates how we create.

Your mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action)

• Architect the Roadmap: Translate On’s 2030 LRP and annual goals into a multi-year strategic roadmap for Footwear Product Creation

• Strategic Prioritization: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the footwear portfolio, ensuring technical breakthroughs are sequenced and resourced for maximum commercial impact.

Portfolio Strategy & Operating Rhythm

• Own seasonal range portfolio planning: capacity modeling, resource allocation, project prioritization

• Design and manage the Footwear Creation operating rhythm: weekly leadership standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic planning

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development | Accessories
jobs.description:
In short

We are looking for a visionary and technically proficient Head of Product Development | to lead our accessories product engine. This is a critical leadership role where you will be responsible for translating creative concepts into highly functional, durable, and commercially viable (technical) performance and lifestyle accessories. You will lead a high-performing team, drive product innovation, and own the development process from initial prototyping to final production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and sustainability. This role will report into the Global Senior Director of Product Creation + Sourcing.

Your mission

Your mission is to execute the accessories development strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall brand, product, and financial goals. You will oversee development and successful commercialization from ideation to launch, including engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final specifications. You will deliver against gross margin targets, manage department budgets while optimising costs. You will also provide collaborative leadership to align teams and foster an innovative work environment that encourages creativity, risk-taking and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute overall accessories development strategy and map out a roadmap which aligns with the overall brand, product, and financial goals

• Oversee all development and ensure commercialization of the product range from ideation to launch, including development engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final product specifications

• Work as a partner to Design, Materials, Innovation, Product Management, and Sourcing teams to ensure successful delivery of seasonal products and execute strategic vision for the business

• Deliver against gross margin targets and manage department budgets while optimizing on costs

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive threats, and new market opportunities

• Support and partner with our Sourcing teams in Asia & Europe on building a robust global sourcing strategy that emphasises high-quality products, world-class partnerships, service, ethical sourcing and sustainability

• Implement supply chain initiatives, in partnership with our ESG team, that reduce environmental impact, such as using recycled and preferred materials, advanced water treatment and color dyeing technologies and optimising logistics with initiatives like localisation

• Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends to identify and oversee the development of innovative accessories that meet performance, durability, and sustainability requirements, which will instigate new ways of thinking about products

• Establish and enforce rigorous product testing and quality control protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and brand requirements

• Spearhead and streamline product development and manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce complexity and time to market

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, engage with industry stakeholders, including athletes and sports professionals and work with the cross-functional stakeholders to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into future product designs.

Your story

• 15+ years of experience in accessories (hard and soft goods), including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role.

• Hold a deep understanding of sports accessory trends and competitor landscapes, with a proven ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities, to drive growth and innovation within the accessories category

• Proven track record of successful team leadership and the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse group of professionals, ability to influence stakeholders, and to translate technical complexities for non-technical audiences

• Expert knowledge of technical textiles, manufacturing processes, and "design for manufacturing" principles, alongside proficiency in the latest creation software.

• A strong commitment to sustainability and a history of implementing sustainability initiatives in product development and sourcing

• Experienced in global supply chain management, optimising processes for efficiency, cost reduction, and quality

• Familiarity with the latest creation software and technologies relevant to accessory design, development and production.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically- to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
